svg.aria-label: MERIDIAN roadmap board: shipped and next up

g.text: ✓ v0.1 — the world, the stat compiler, the seeded backtest
✓ three houses — anthropic · openai · xai, 101x apart on price
✓ cost-adjusted P&L — the inference bill is subtracted
✓ persistence + CI — survives a reload, green on every push
✓ paper alpha — real quotes, virtual funds, no keys at all
✓ rebrand — MERIDIAN identity: navy/brass, serif display
✓ token-launch scope removed from product, docs and specs
1 the real buy and sell paths on the router
2 prove the OpenAI and xAI wires against a live 200
3 latency measured per house, never assumed
4 leaderboard: rank rival builds on net, not gross
5 replay export — a seed plus a build as a file
6 real prices — decode the Uniswap v4 swaps
hosted service split · mobile layout · a fourth house, only with a reason
ordering rule: what would embarrass the project if someone read it today comes before what would impress them
